sentences.en: Noah made an ark of wood
sentences.pt: Noé fez uma arca de madeira

sentences.en: The animals came into the ark
sentences.pt: Os animais entraram na arca

sentences.en: God shut the door of the ark
sentences.pt: Deus fechou a porta da arca

sentences.en: The wickedness of man was great in the earth
sentences.pt: A maldade do homem era grande sobre a terra

sentences.en: But Noah found grace in the eyes of the LORD
alt: But Noah found grace in the eyes of the Lord
sentences.pt: Mas Noé achou graça aos olhos do Senhor

sentences.en: Noah was a righteous man and walked with God
alt: Noah was a just man and walked with God
sentences.pt: Noé era um homem justo e andava com Deus

sentences.en: God said, Make an ark of gopher wood
alt: God said, Make you an ark of gopher wood
sentences.pt: Deus disse: Faze uma arca de madeira de gofer

sentences.en: The ark was three hundred cubits long
sentences.pt: A arca tinha trezentos côvados de comprimento

sentences.en: The animals went in two by two, male and female
sentences.pt: Os animais entraram dois a dois, macho e fêmea

sentences.en: Noah, his wife and his three sons went into the ark
sentences.pt: Noé, sua mulher e seus três filhos entraram na arca

sentences.en: Eight people were saved in the ark
sentences.pt: Oito pessoas foram salvas na arca

sentences.en: The LORD shut him in
sentences.pt: O Senhor o fechou por fora

verse.text: Make thee an ark of gopher wood.
verse.pt: Faze para ti uma arca de madeira de gofer.

reading.text: The earth was full of violence, but Noah found grace. God said to Noah: Make an ark of wood. Noah made the ark, and the animals came in two by two.
reading.pt: A terra estava cheia de violência, mas Noé achou graça. Deus disse a Noé: Faze uma arca de madeira. Noé fez a arca, e os animais entraram dois a dois.
reading.q: How did the animals come in?

dialogue.pt: Noé, o que você está fazendo?

quiz.q: Who shut the door of the ark?
quiz.explain: Quando todos entraram, o Senhor o fechou por fora (Gênesis 7:16).

sentences.en: The rain was upon the earth
sentences.pt: Houve chuva sobre a terra

sentences.en: Forty days and forty nights
sentences.pt: Quarenta dias e quarenta noites

sentences.en: The water covered the mountains
sentences.pt: A água cobriu as montanhas

sentences.en: Noah opened the window of the ark
sentences.pt: Noé abriu a janela da arca

sentences.en: Noah was six hundred years old when the flood came
sentences.pt: Noé tinha seiscentos anos quando veio o dilúvio

sentences.en: The windows of heaven were opened
sentences.pt: As janelas dos céus se abriram

sentences.en: The ark went upon the face of the waters
sentences.pt: A arca andava sobre as águas

sentences.en: Everything that lived on the earth died in the flood
sentences.pt: Tudo o que vivia sobre a terra morreu no dilúvio

sentences.en: Only Noah remained alive, and those with him in the ark
sentences.pt: Ficou somente Noé vivo, e os que com ele estavam na arca

sentences.en: God remembered Noah, and the waters went down
sentences.pt: Deus se lembrou de Noé, e as águas diminuíram

sentences.en: The ark rested on the mountains of Ararat
sentences.pt: A arca repousou sobre os montes de Ararate

sentences.en: Noah sent out a raven, and it went back and forth
sentences.pt: Noé soltou um corvo, e ele ia e voltava

verse.text: And the rain was upon the earth forty days and forty nights.
verse.pt: E houve chuva sobre a terra quarenta dias e quarenta noites.

reading.text: The rain was upon the earth forty days and forty nights. The water covered the high mountains. Only Noah remained alive, and those with him in the ark.
reading.pt: A chuva caiu sobre a terra quarenta dias e quarenta noites. A água cobriu os altos montes. Ficou somente Noé vivo, e os que com ele estavam na arca.

options: Let us go into the ark.
Let us go to the desert.
dialogue.answer: Let us go into the ark.

quiz.explain: A arca repousou sobre os montes de Ararate (Gênesis 8:4).

sentences.en: The dove came back to him
sentences.pt: A pomba voltou para ele

sentences.en: Never again will a flood destroy the earth
sentences.pt: Nunca mais um dilúvio destruirá a terra

sentences.en: Noah sent a dove
sentences.pt: Noé enviou uma pomba

sentences.en: I set my rainbow in the cloud
sentences.pt: Eu ponho o meu arco-íris na nuvem

sentences.en: I will remember my promise
sentences.pt: Eu me lembrarei da minha promessa

sentences.en: But the dove found no rest for her foot
sentences.pt: Mas a pomba não achou repouso para o seu pé

sentences.en: In the evening the dove came with an olive leaf
sentences.pt: À tarde a pomba voltou com uma folha de oliveira

sentences.en: Noah sent the dove again, and it did not return
sentences.pt: Noé soltou a pomba de novo, e ela não voltou mais

sentences.en: Noah built an altar to the LORD
alt: Noah built an altar to the Lord
sentences.pt: Noé edificou um altar ao Senhor

sentences.en: God made a covenant with Noah and every living creature
sentences.pt: Deus fez um concerto com Noé e todo ser vivente

sentences.en: The waters shall no more become a flood to destroy all flesh
alt: The waters will no more become a flood to destroy all flesh
sentences.pt: As águas não se tornarão mais em dilúvio para destruir toda carne

sentences.en: The rainbow is the sign of the covenant
sentences.pt: O arco-íris é o sinal do concerto

verse.text: I do set my bow in the cloud, and it shall be for a token of a covenant between me and the earth.
verse.pt: O meu arco tenho posto nas nuvens; este será por sinal do concerto entre mim e a terra.

reading.text: Noah sent a dove, but it found no rest. Seven days later the dove came back with an olive leaf. Then God set a rainbow in the cloud as a promise.
reading.pt: Noé enviou uma pomba, mas ela não achou repouso. Sete dias depois a pomba voltou com uma folha de oliveira. Então Deus pôs um arco-íris na nuvem como promessa.

quiz.q: What did Noah build when he came out of the ark?
quiz.explain: Noé edificou um altar ao Senhor e ofereceu holocaustos (Gênesis 8:20).
